messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.50 EUR per unit (offer:70240-0).
Your rolling quality to 2026Q3 stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. 

Your third package with 14 days payment is best for us right now to keep the shop running smoothly. We don't have the office staff for a detailed cost breakdown, but this is a fair price for the 4,200 pieces. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 29.50 EUR per unit (offer:70250-2).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could your commercial manager review and approve your best price on the attached terms, including our stated binding volume commitment?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I checked the numbers and the 4,200 pieces, so I'm giving you our best price of 28.00 EUR per piece. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We need the fast payment to keep the cash flowing, so your package with 14 days payment is what we go with.

We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot is a price of €28.79 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
